faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) for the project 'NOCI Monitoring' located in Puducherry.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Data Entry Operator under the healthcare sector on a contract basis for a project duration.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are announced for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Data Entry Operator post under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a UG or PG degree in Life Sciences along with relevant experience in data entry, especially within the health field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to JIPMER Data Entry Operator jobs?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 30 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criterion before applying.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 20,000 per month, with no other allowances payable during the contract period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application via email?
faq.answer: The last date to send complete applications along with all supporting documents through email is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The date and time of the interview for the Data Entry Operator position is scheduled to be held on 16-10-2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for JIPMER Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted exclusively via email by sending the filled application form and documents to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this JIPMER recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Data Entry Operator position comprises a written test followed by an interview for qualified candidates.
